claim: On March 1, 2017 Powell was named as one of three potential applicants to fill the vacant Supreme Court seat, the other two applicants being Judge Lisa White Hardwick and attorney Benjamin A. Lipman.
extract: Eric Greitens will choose between Judge Lisa White Hardwick, Benjamin A. Lipman and Judge W. Brent Powell to be his final nominee to the seat vacated by the late Judge Richard Teitelman.

claim: The polling through most of the race was close and no candidate was a definitive favorite.
extract: "Overwhelmingly, the state said we get things done," Walker told his cabinet at a Wednesday afternoon meeting.
